title: Purpose-separated A-signed cooperative two-member Ready (draft)
description: Machine A signs ASCII agent-bot/soul-cooperative-member-ready/v3, one NUL byte and exact RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 payload bytes with the installed secure-admin Ed25519 authority.
